advisory.required_authentication_precondition: SNI-specific mutual TLS must be the sole authentication gate, the SNI-specific SslContext must require client certificates, and the fallback/default context must be more permissive with no secondary peer-certificate verification.

component_probe.scope_limit: The EmbeddedChannel component probe demonstrates vulnerable/fixed SniHandler selection behavior only; it does not establish a Minecraft exploit path or an authentication bypass.

limitations: This is a bytecode/string-reference scan and does not execute every game version or instrument arbitrary runtime-generated bytecode.
No custom launcher, Java agent, third-party mod set, or modified network pipeline was captured.
The component-level Netty SNI probe establishes vulnerable fallback behavior only when an SniHandler is actually constructed; it is not a Minecraft runtime exploit.
Minecraft owns the affected libraries; no compatible Mojang update or project-controlled dependency override was applied.
exact_official_classpath_scan.method: Scan every .class entry in each exact Minecraft client JAR and every default runtime libraries.artifact JAR from the pinned Mojang version metadata. Search constant-pool/classfile bytes for SniHandler binary names (including reflective class-name strings) and Netty SslHandler/SslContext references. Native classifiers are not Java classpath JARs and are excluded.

findings.authentication: The dedicated management endpoint uses an API-key check in AuthenticationHandler; the observed Netty client-auth mode is NONE. This is not an SNI-selected mTLS gate.
findings.dedicated_server_management_endpoint: In 1.21.10, 1.21.11 and 26.3 the TLS-related game classes map to DedicatedServer, ManagementServer, the channel initializer and JsonRpcSslContextProvider. The endpoint is a dedicated-server feature; the integrated client server class has no management-server or SNI reference in the inspected binaries.
findings.effective_server_configuration: The exact DedicatedServerProperties constructors default management-server-enabled=false, host=localhost, and management-server-tls-enabled=true. The endpoint is constructed only inside DedicatedServer when explicitly enabled; an operator may configure a remote bind host. Across all eight exact affected Netty handler versions, javap of SslContextBuilder shows its constructor initializes ClientAuth.NONE. The 1.21.10, 1.21.11 and 26.3 game providers call forServer(keyManager).trustManager(trustManager).build() and do not call clientAuth().
findings.game_client_and_integrated_server: The 1.21.10 and 26.3 game packet path bytecode is separately source-bound in the packet-path capture index. The 1.21.10 packet initializer uses a game packet pipeline over Netty sockets; the 26.3 Connection capture shows the current packet pipeline. Exact IntegratedServer class constant-pool checks for 1.21.10, 1.21.11 and 26.3 find no management-server, SniHandler, SslHandler or SslContext reference. The full 29-version scan finds no non-Netty SniHandler call or reflective class-name reference.
findings.pipeline: When a non-null SslContext is supplied, ManagementServer$1 adds sslContext.newHandler(channel.alloc()) directly to the channel pipeline, then HttpServerCodec, HttpObjectAggregator, AuthenticationHandler, WebSocketServerProtocolHandler, frame aggregation, and JSON-RPC handlers. No SniHandler is constructed or inserted.

reachability_conclusion.confidence: High for the exact unmodified official Mojang binaries and manifests scanned; insufficient to clear modded/custom-launcher deployment scope.
reachability_conclusion.disposition: Further investigation with the 26.2 occurrence retaining its source-bound Upstream-dependent remediation classification
reachability_conclusion.official_unmodified_vanilla_client_and_i: No SniHandler constructor, pipeline entry, or reflective class-name reference exists outside Netty handler implementation classes across the exact 29 official client/runtime classpaths. The observed dedicated-server management TLS endpoint uses SslHandler directly, has clientAuth NONE, and uses API-key authentication; its default enabled flag is false. The CVE-specific fallback/mTLS gate is not reached by these inspected first-party paths.
reachability_conclusion.third_party_mods_custom_launchers_agents: Not scanned. Arbitrary third-party mods, launcher-added classpaths, Java agents, runtime-generated code and pipeline mutations can create SniHandler or change authentication. No global non-reachability claim is made for those configurations.

remediation.project_control: Minecraft owns the resolved game runtime. No compatible Mojang update is present in the affected manifests. No mod-level override was applied because it would replace game-managed modules and compatibility is not established.
required_follow_up: Inspect supported third-party mod sets, custom launcher classpaths and runtime agents or require a bounded supported environment before changing the overall disposition.
Request/consume a compatible Mojang runtime update to Netty 4.1.137.Final or 4.2.17.Final where these game lines remain supported.
Retain the current blocker until scope and upstream update requirements are satisfied.
